scope: IQ2 halfword load experiment versus frozen original implementation and pinned mx Vulkan. P512/G128 same released GGUF, F32 KV, auto F16, ubatch 512, 4 threads. Three total warmups (one per arm) and twelve measured calls (four per arm) retained per format; final profile is diagnostic only. This is a small screen, not full qualification or merge pass.
interpretation: Rates are tok/s; higher is faster. PP and TG are separate empty-history benchmark phases, not request latency. Reported means and paired percentage deltas retain all measured blocks. Results do not establish a general workload tradeoff or causal attribution; this is not full correctness/performance qualification.

activity.limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.

native_fixture_evidence.scope: Combined device output for both IQ2 formats: embed_ids invalid rows and F32 matmul/grouped/residual/routed operators; tile threshold 40 with row edge 39/tile edge 41 and row/tile timestamp witnesses; 960 range products and five threshold cases per format. Native transcript is bundled once in the XXS directory; execution records native_passed=true for both formats.

lifecycle_provenance.state_snapshot_order: The runner calls docker inspect and stores container State before docker rm -f; after docker rm -f returns successfully it sets removed=true. The snapshot can therefore show Running=true while removed=true is the expected final lifecycle record.
lifecycle_provenance.state_snapshot_interpretation: Expected pre-removal inspection snapshot, not evidence that the container remained running after the runner completed.
